title: dot log record v1 (one line of $XDG_STATE_HOME/dot/<domain>/log.jsonl)
description: Written by dot_log (lib/dot/log.sh). Metadata only: names, counts and ids, never prompts or file contents. Records older than DOT_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS (30) are pruned by the maintenance job.

domain.description: The command's domain, or cli outside one

event.description: What happened, snake_case; metric, session_<event> (agent) and fleet_<event> (fleet) are reserved

trace_id.description: DOT_TRACE_ID: one per invocation, shared by its child commands

data.description: The KEY=VALUE arguments, as strings; a metric has name, value and unit
